about: The Bellwood JJ Fish & Chicken on Mannheim Road is a carryout counter for Chicago-style fried fish and chicken: wings, legs and thighs, tenders, catfish, perch and shrimp dinners with fries and bread, plus family-size fish and party-wing trays and Southern desserts.
tagline: Hot fried fish, wings and shrimp on Mannheim Road
hours: Online ordering hours 11:00 AM – 10:40 PM (order.online store page)
notes: No store-specific website found; jjfish-chicago.com belongs to a different JJ Fish operator (5211 W North Ave / Maywood) and was not used. Address 528 Mannheim Rd confirmed on the ordering page. Google lists the store as open until 12 AM, which differs from the online-ordering hours. Phone (708) 544-0505 appears only on Yelp, not on an official page, so left blank. Photos are the store's DoorDash ordering-page dish photography; no inviting Bellwood interior photos exist (only storefront/counter shots), so no atmosphere photos.
